explication: Laravel Mpdf is a Laravel adapter around mPDF. An application controller calls the PDF facade, which resolves the package binding and uses the wrapper to accept raw HTML, files, or rendered Blade views; chunked variants split content before loading. The core builder merges Laravel configuration and per-call overrides, configures mPDF, and exposes output as a string, saved file, download, or inline response. The sampled source confirms these runtime paths; broader mPDF features remain configuration- or engine-provided.
